SourceEligibilityRule: For the local numeric pilot, record the pinned training distribution's provenance/intended use and each included snapshot's verified license evidence and exceptions. A missing dataset-card field alone is not a veto. Unknown or conflicting historical conditions remain explicit pending rows, not silently eligible. Do not present current GitHub terms as proof of historical issue author permissions.
CohortRule: Keep train7335, validation5686 and final2402 membership fixed. Pending permission/catalog/target rows remain in coverage denominators and cannot be converted to training negatives or successes. Record any source-based exclusion reason before fitting, not after model scores. Do not move or replace excluded tasks across roles. No final scoring during development.
ModelRule: Fit only original small numeric weights on generic label-free features. Keep raw query text, token/path vocabulary, task/repository IDs, patch bodies and per-task feature/target rows local. No raw-text-generation objective or upstream encoder fine-tuning is approved by this narrow policy.
ExperimentRule: Precommit objective, losses, seeds, resource limits, baseline controls and validation selection before cost-label inspection/fitting. Do not use the new path schema with old small-catalog weights. First establish useful full-precision signal; any ternary experiment remains separately measured, never presumed faster or equally accurate.
ReleaseRule: Public model release requires a separate source/notice review for actual inputs and weights, license compatibility, non-memorizing artifact content review, immutable HF hashes and reproducible quality/resource evidence. No raw data or weights in Git. CI enforces technical checks, not a blanket legal opinion. No production default change without demonstrated utility.
